sample_unit: annotated neurosurgical video clips/questions (9 hours of video, 89 procedures, 68 anatomical structures)
models_evaluated: over 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs (individual names not given in text)

links.outcome: MLLM accuracy on neurosurgical anatomical structure identification benchmark
links.effect: Best-performing MLLM achieved only 40.87% accuracy in anatomical identification; best of four trainees scored 56%, lowest 28%, average 46.5%.
links.quote: Experiments on over 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal significant limitations, with the best-performing model achieving only 40.87% accuracy in anatomical identification tasks.

screen.reason: The paper establishes a new benchmark (NeuroABench) evaluating multimodal large language models on neurosurgical anatomy identification against trainee performance, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
